uplink.description: Full profile uplink: 8 soil depths (moisture % + temperature °C) and battery, both sensor blocks present (flags 0x0003)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds payload; per-depth moisture raws chosen so (raw-2500)/500 lands in [0,100] %, temperature raws so (raw-32768)/100 lands at 20-27 °C, battery raw 3600 -> 3.6 V. expected.data derived by running reference/upstream-codec.js on this input and mapping its raw per-depth values onto the reserved channels array (one entry per connected depth, labels depth0..depth7); whole-device battery stays top-level.

uplink.description: Partial profile: depth0 fully connected, depth1 temperature-only, depths 2-7 disconnected (sentinel words) — sentinel values and empty depths are omitted
uplink._note: Synthetic sentinel payload: depth0 words 4000/34268 -> moisture 3 % / temperature 15 °C; depth1 moisture word 0 -> sentinel -5 (dropped, outside 0-100 %) with temperature word 33768 -> 10 °C kept; depths 2-7 all-zero words -> both sentinels (-5, -327.68) -> no channels entry. Battery word 3000 -> 3 V. Pins the per-value bounds gating and entry omission a standard 6-level probe relies on.

uplink.description: Battery-only uplink: profile block absent, only the 1-word battery block present (flags 0x0002)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds payload; flags 0x0002 selects only the battery block. expected.data derived from reference/upstream-codec.js (battery raw 3600 -> 3.6 V).

uplink.description: Wrong protocol version byte is rejected
uplink._note: Synthetic error payload; reference/upstream-codec.js returns {error: "protocol version 3 doesn't match v2"} for a non-2 version byte.
